senses.gloss: m. (reduplic. of קטן) a subordinate officer, attendant of a magistrate.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 54:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. LIV, 3</cite> <he>ק׳ שהוא רודף לאדם וכ׳</he> ed. Bub. (oth. ed. <he>אחר חבירו</he>, corr. acc.) if an attendant persecutes a man, he may complain against him to the lieutenant (hyparch), and if the lieutenant persecutes him, he may complain to the king; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 771">Yalk. ib. 771</cite> <he>קְטַנְתָּן … קובל עליו לאפיקורוס וכ׳</he> (read: <he>לאפיטרופוס</he>) if an attendant …, he appeals to the proconsul &c.
